Intersects the features of a vector with the polygons of another vector, keeping the attributes of both.

**Toolbox folder:** Vector Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Vector, Intersect, Overlay, Attributes<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.VectorIntersector`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inMap1` | vector file |  |  | The vector to intersect: points, lines or polygons. |
| `inMap2` | vector file |  |  | The polygons to intersect with. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outMap` | output file |  | The pieces of the features, with the attributes of the features and of the polygons. |
